decision.reason: Independent risk audit needs-correction (learner-critical-answer): Indonesian departemen fits the workplace-unit sense. In Malaysian Malay, jabatan is strongly associated with government or university departments; DBP gives bahagian for a department in a business concern. The broad workplace cue therefore overstates jabatan. The card also omits the useful false-friend contrast: Indonesian jabatan commonly means an official position/function, not a department.
